# 07.18 XAL specification: Example

## Example

<frame width="1440" height="900" class="pa-4">
  <container class="pa-4">
    <row gap="20" class="mb-2">
      <col span="8" class="pa-2">
        <card title="Dashboard" />
      </col>
      <col span="4" class="pa-2">
        <card title="Summary" />
      </col>
    </row>

    <row gap="20">
